title: Synthetic Factory Repository Alias Cache v1
description: Shape of config/eval-exclusion/repo-aliases.json (#494): the offline, timestamped record of where each repository name resolved, so compose canonicalizes renames and transfers without touching the network. pipelines/eval_exclusion_aliases.py is the authoritative loader: it also requires canonical exact-JSON bytes, entries sorted by unique name, every resolved_at no later than updated_at, and a closed cache in which every canonical target has its own self-entry. scripts/refresh_repo_aliases.py writes github_api entries through gh api repos/<owner>/<name>.

method.description: The canonical name is asserted by a committed, reviewed source catalog named in evidence; no GitHub API call was made.
